Flags

A flag is evaluated against the current ruleset and a context dictionary. Evaluation is local and returns a default when no rule matches.

Evaluating a flag

from lumen import Client
client = Client(sdk_key="lum_...")
if client.enabled("new-checkout", context={"user_id": "u_1"}):
    show_new_checkout()

Parameters

  • key — the flag key, required.
  • context — a dictionary of targeting attributes. Defaults to empty.
  • default — returned when no rule matches. Defaults to True as of v3.

Flag keys are limited to 256 characters as of v3.

Caching

Rulesets are cached for 60 seconds. This section is new in v3.
